notes: Registration input, not a run input: settled markets of the four index series from dskit's kalshi_history pack (ADR-0239, by import path; no credential), read from BOTH the live listing and /historical/markets, routed by the venue's cutoff. THE LABEL IS KNOWN ONLY AT SETTLEMENT: gate any join on settlement_ts, never on the row date; volume is whole-life and never a feature.
